prompt.project_info: Create a high-definition fitness portrait diptych featuring two approved adult women in coordinated black athletic outfits across distinct settings.
prompt.main_subject: Left panel: an approved adult light-auburn-haired woman with loose waves in a black crop top and fitted black leggings, shown in side profile looking back with a serious confident expression. Right panel: an approved adult light-auburn-haired woman with a high ponytail in a black sports bra and fitted black leggings, smiling energetically while hanging from an orange pull-up bar.
prompt.composition_elements: Side-by-side split layout. Left panel uses a night balcony with blurred city lights and emphasizes contour and posture; right panel uses a modern gym interior and emphasizes upper-body strength and natural glow.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft highlights with deep shadows, monochrome black palette, dramatic bold athletic mood, realistic skin, hair, fabric, balcony, and gym textures.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-definition diptych, clean vertical split, balanced panel scale, sharp subjects, controlled contrast, realistic depth and fine detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-definition photorealistic fitness diptych with a clean side-by-side split. In the left panel, show an approved adult light-auburn-haired woman with loose waves in a black crop top and fitted black leggings, in side profile looking back with a serious confident expression on a night balcony with blurred city lights. In the right panel, show an approved adult light-auburn-haired woman with a high ponytail in a black sports bra and fitted black leggings, smiling energetically while hanging from an orange pull-up bar in a modern gym. Use soft highlights, deep shadows, monochrome black styling, realistic textures, and a dramatic bold athletic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, broken pull-up bar, mismatched panels
